description: Promote an experiment's winning variant: the experiment ends and every user then gets that variant's price, from the experiment pricing API and from the Elo A/B test built-in. The results are kept. Answers 404 not_released where this is not released for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

experiment_key.description: The experiment key: key on a list_experiments result, lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

variant.description: The name of the variant to promote, as on get_experiment_definition.

name: promote_experiment_winner
